title: Trace
description: An index of one Droid session. The conversation stays in the Droid session. A step stores ids and a git snapshot ref, not tool input or output.

harness.description: Harness that produced the session. The demo harness is droid. Claude Code is an optional adapter.

task_id.description: SWE-bench instance id when the task comes from SWE-bench.

harness_session_id.description: Session id that Droid resumeSession accepts. The optional Claude Code adapter stores the id resumeSessionAt accepts.

tool_call_id.description: Id the snapshot is tagged with. Replay jobs refer to this, not a step index. This is the SDK tool-use id, not the message id.

message_id.description: Droid messageId. session.rewind targets this id.

snapshot_ref.description: Commit id from recorder/capture/snapshot.sh, pinned under refs/retrace/ in the task repo. It includes untracked files that are not ignored. Git snapshots are the source of truth for repo state.
